title: Acceptance probability of the matrix BLR tester
statement: For any natural number $n$, any function $\ell:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$, and any function $q:\mathbb{F}_2^{n\times n}\to\mathbb{F}_2$, the tester that independently samples uniformly random binary matrices $A$ and $B$, queries the oracle at $A$, $B$, and $A+B$, and accepts exactly when the first two answers sum to the third has the same acceptance probability as the three-query BLR tester applied to the function on $\mathbb{F}_2^{n^2}$ that sends a flattened matrix to its value under $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ is a function from $n\times n$ binary matrices to $\mathbb{F}_2$
